title: Deals & comparison page with flash-deal countdown and coupons — electronics store
notes: v1 renders the flash-deal countdown inside the <flash-countdown> web component's shadow root; v2 is a MUI v5 (Mui* + emotion css-*) rebuild that renders the countdown in light DOM and inserts a 'Deal of the Day' section with its own role=timer countdown above it. The compare tray moves into <amp-compare-dock>'s shadow root ('Compare now' → 'Compare 2 items'). Deal cards become MUI Grid/Card markup sorted by biggest savings, lose ids/data-sku (coupon ids survive as analytics attributes), 'Compare' becomes 'Add to compare'. Category tabs become role=tab links in a new order, a 'Shop deals by category' block repeats 'Monitors', and a 'Top deals right now' rail repeats the Lumen Book Pro 14 price.
